— St. Petersburg? I literally just said Tver. Maybe you should try listening instead of just waiting for your turn to talk.

— Marinka needs to keep her mouth shut. And I didn't "quit," I stopped. There's a difference. As for the party...

I pulled my headphones up and slid them over my ears, cutting him off with a sharp movement.

— I'm not a circus act. Find someone else to entertain you.
